constraints: an integer coefficient multiplies the exponential and is divided out first; what remains is an exact power of the base or an exact logarithm
hints: First isolate the exponential term by dividing away the numerical coefficient.
Check whether the isolated right side is a simple power of the base before choosing a logarithm method.
If logs are needed, take logs of both sides, use the power rule, and solve the resulting linear equation in the exponent.
